items.information: There are two competitions being held in Central Square at St. Mary Orthodox Church on June 1st: this competition, A Morning in Central Square 2024, in the morning, and An Afternoon in Central Square 2024 in the afternoon. **These are not series competitions. You may sign up for either or both.** A Morning in Central Square will have 3x3, 2x2, and pyraminx. An Afternoon in Central Square will have Square-1, 5x5, Clock, and 3x3 Blindfolded. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorthamptonNewcomersA2024#38747-competitor-information) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years of age.

items.name: See Georgia: Lake Russell A 2024

venue.name: [Richard B. Russell State Park](https://gastateparks.org/RichardBRussell)
venue.address: 2650 Russell State Park Drive, Elberton, GA 30635

items.information: Entering and parking at Richard B. Russell State Park costs $5 per vehicle per day. Please review the [Travel](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeeGeorgiaLakeRussellA2024#41542-travel), [Venue](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeeGeorgiaLakeRussellA2024#41543-venue), and [Free Parking Through Your Local Library!](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeeGeorgiaLakeRussellA2024#41544-free-parking-through-your-local-library) tabs before registering to ensure you have a plan to travel to and access the park. This competition takes place in conjunction with the Elberton, GA location of the worldwide [FMC 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMC2024) competition, with FMC 2024 taking place from 6am to 10:30am at a location about 15 minutes away and this competition taking place from 12pm to 9pm. Please review the [FMC 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeeGeorgiaLakeRussellA2024#41883-fmc-2024) tab if you are interested in participating in both competitions. This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org/).

items.information: Els socis de l'ACSC reben un descompte del 15% després de la competició. Pots fer-te soci de l'ACSC [aquí](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat). Els i les joves de Vilafranca del Penedès d'entre 13 i 30 anys també reben aquest descompte per aquesta competició. Los socios de la ACSC reciben un descuento del 15% después de la competición. Puedes hacerte socio de la ACSC [aquí](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat). Los y las jóvenes de Vilafranca del Penedès de entre 13 y 30 años también reciben este descuento por esta competición. The ACSC members will receive a 15% discount after the end of the competition. You can become a member of the ACSC [here](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat). Persons from Vilafranca del Penedès aged between 13 and 30 also receive this discount for this competition.
